WFAM.Title: WFRP 4e Automated Miscasts
WFAM.Settings.Enabled.Name: Post miscasts as draggable cards
WFAM.Settings.Enabled.Hint: When a miscast table is rolled (from a casting or channelling card, an @Table link or /table), post a miscast card. Results with automation can be dragged onto a character sheet or token to apply them as a temporary effect; narrative results are a plain card. Turn off for the system's plain text result.
WFAM.Card.DragHint: Drag this card onto a character sheet or token to apply the miscast as a temporary effect.
WFAM.Effect.NoCastingToast: You cannot cast or channel spells right now.
WFAM.Card.DragHintArea: Drag this card onto the canvas (or the caster's sheet) to place the miscast's area.
WFAM.Drop.AreaNeedsCanvas: This miscast affects an area: drag it onto the canvas, or give the caster a token on the scene.
WFAM.Drop.NoActor: Drop the miscast onto a character sheet or a token.
WFAM.Forget.Title: Forgetfulness: {actor}
WFAM.Forget.Prompt: The spell is lost to your memory. Choose the memorised spell to un-memorise:
WFAM.Effect.LashTurn: Major Miscast at start of turn
